steps.name: nested-render
steps.summary: Recursive frame-in-frame calendar: CalendarBlock renders subtasks as inset, time-positioned child blocks (arbitrary depth) in both Plan/Action columns; parent blocks auto-expand to wrap overflowing children via new pure core/time fitParentToChildren + clampChildToParent (with tests); '+ subtask' creates a one-level-deeper child (childTypeOf) optimistically.

steps.name: nested-drag
steps.summary: Nested subtask blocks now drag-move and edge-resize at any depth (dnd-kit ids namespaced by column+node, 15-min snap, optimistic useUpdateNode) in both Plan and Action columns; per-minute pixel scale is constant through nesting so the grid's minute math is depth-agnostic. On commit, handleDragEnd walks the visible-parent chain, clamping each child inside its parent (clampChildToParent) and stretching ancestors' stored spans to wrap overflowing children (fitParentToChildren), cascading to arbitrary depth; render-time fit keeps the live drag preview wrapping too.
